anomalies.observed: On the M-BUS connector J4 (Conn_01x04), pin 4 carries NET0019 and pin 3 carries NET0038 (labelled 5V), and pin 1 goes to GND. Pin 2 has no wire or label, so it appears unconnected.
anomalies.expected: The spec lists J6 (PortB) as carrying GND, +5V and two GPIOs, /PORTB1 and /PORTB2, passed through from J1/J2. Pin 2 should therefore be wired to the second PortB GPIO from the bus.

evidence.quote: J6 (4-pin) carries GND, +5V, and two GPIOs (`/PORTB1`, `/PORTB2`) through from J1/J2, implementing the "M5Unit PortB" feature
M-BUS block: Conn_01x04 J4 with pin 4 labelled NET0019, pin 3 labelled NET0038 and 5V, pin 1 to GND; no label or wire at pin 2

anomalies.impact: The second PortB GPIO is not available to accessory units, so a PortB unit that needs that signal will not work.

anomalies.observed: R13 is drawn as a 10k resistor in the +3V3 to Q3-base pull-up position, but the annotation "Short R13, R14 for Serial Servo" says R13 is a 0 Ω jumper to be shorted in serial mode. The servo-bus bridge on the sheet is R14 (0 Ω) plus R12 (0 Ω).
anomalies.expected: Per the spec, R13 and R14 are both 0 Ω jumpers that bridge the two servo signal pins in serial mode, so the annotated jumper should be a 0 Ω part in the bridge path.

evidence.quote: R13 10k (base pull-up at +3V3) and annotation "Short R13, R14 for Serial Servo"
R13, R14 | 0 Ω (jumpers) | When shorted, bridge J3-pin3 and J8-pin3 together and onto the MAX3485 TTL bus

anomalies.impact: Following the on-board instruction in serial mode would short the Q3 base pull-up and leave the servo bus bridge in a different state than the assembly note describes, so serial mode may not be configured correctly. The mismatch may be a reference-designator inconsistency rather than a fault.

parsed.summary: The servo, power and transceiver networks broadly match the spec, but the PortB connector J4 appears to leave pin 2 unconnected, so one of the two PortB GPIOs is missing. The R13 jumper annotation also conflicts with the 10k value drawn for R13, which is a lower-confidence reference-designator issue.
